page.layout: One column of text below a decorative ornament border: a heading, then a numbered list of eight chapter entries with page numbers at the right. Left edge strips belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
page.notes: Ornamental border at top, not transcribed. Page numbers at the right of entries 2 and 3 sit on the line below the entry ("5.", "11.", "15."). Entry 1 reads "Pag.1." as printed. The mark after "CAPITUM" may be a colon or semicolon; marked as read. Left edge text strips are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
